about.description: Aster is a next-generation decentralized perpetual and spot exchange formed from the 2025 merger of Astherus (multi-asset liquidity) and APX Finance (perpetual DEX), and powered by Aster Chain — a high-performance privacy-focused L1. Backed by YZi Labs (formerly Binance Labs, CZ-affiliated), PancakeSwap, and additional ecosystem partners, Aster offers perpetual futures with up to 1001× leverage across BNB Chain, Ethereum, Solana, and Arbitrum. Markets are margined in USD1 (the World Liberty Financial stablecoin) and feature a "Trade & Earn" model that lets users post yield-bearing assets as margin.
about.registryInfo: Aster was formed in 2025 from the merger of Astherus (a multi-asset liquidity protocol) and APX Finance (a decentralized perpetuals platform). The project is backed by YZi Labs (formerly Binance Labs, the venture fund associated with Binance co-founders Changpeng Zhao "CZ" and Yi He, managing $10B+ for early Binance executives), with PancakeSwap (BNB Chain's leading DEX) and other ecosystem partners. Aster Chain — a high-performance privacy-focused L1 — launched as the venue's native settlement layer in 2025.

fees.revenueNotes: Aster RWA fee schedule during RWA Sprint Season 1 (May 7 - June 7, 2026): 0 bps maker (waived) / 0.9 bps taker on stock, ETF, and commodity perpetual pairs. Standard schedule (post-Sprint): 1 bp maker / 3.5 bps taker. USD1-settled commodity perps charge 1 bp taker with a 0.5 bp maker rebate. Crypto markets (not on this RWA page) charge 1 bp maker / 3.5 bps taker. Source: https://docs.asterdex.com/product/aster-perpetuals/fees-and-specs/perpetual-fees
